verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped API credentials for an agent is a fair question for an agent-orchestration platform with an SDK, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers adjacent controls: Deny/Ask/Allow tool permission lists, project-scoped folder access, and sandbox blocking of sensitive files. None of these documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials or tokens to an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
